caseNameFull: Steven M. Jacob and Daniel T. Meis v. Robert P. Houston, Director, Nebraska Department of Correctional Services

opinions.text: Motion of petitioner Daniel T. Meis for leave to proceed in *250forma pauperis denied. Petitioner is allowed until October 25, 2010, within which to pay the docketing fee required by Rule 38(a) and to submit a petition in compliance with Rule 33.1 of the Rules of this Court. Petition for writ of certiorari as to Steven M. Jacob denied.
